story: Sophie is at the pet shop with her friend Raj. There are three cats sitting on a big, red rug. One fluffy cat jumps off the rug. [emotion:QT/surprised] The cat runs under a chair! Sophie and Raj look under the chair. Sophie reaches in and picks up the cat. [emotion:QT/calm] The cat is soft and warm. Raj holds the cat next. [gesture:clapping] A woman at the shop cheers for Sophie and Raj. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie is proud. Raj is smiling. [emotion:QT/happy] The fluffy cat is purring on the rug. [emotion:QT/calm]
